choices.name: no_express_exception_or_retention

choices.meaning: The disposal duty is displaced or modified by different written instructions from the participant that supplied the information.
choices.name: different_written_instructions_exception

choices.meaning: A copy may be retained solely for archival purposes.
choices.name: archival_copy_retention

choices.meaning: A record copy may be retained only because applicable law requires it.

choices.meaning: The units expressly prohibit retention of the stated copies or derivatives.

choices.meaning: The units contain no qualification of a disposal or retention effect.

examples.quote: (a) within one month of completion of the Purpose or receipt of a written request from the other party, return to the other party all documents and materials (and all copies thereof) containing the other party's Confidential Information and certify in writing to the other party that it has complied with the requirements of this sub-clause; and

Upon termination of this Agreement, all Confidential Information in the possession or control of a Participating Entity and its Representatives that received such information shall be returned to the Participating Entity that disclosed the information, including all copies of such information in any form whatsoever, unless otherwise instructed in writing by the Participating Entity that disclosed the information.

Recipient shall, upon termination of this Agreement, or upon written request of Discloser, whichever is earlier, immediately, but not later than 10 days after any notice thereof by Discloser, return (or destroy at Discloser’s option) all copies of such Discloser’s Confidential Information and certify in writing its compliance with this requirement, except that Recipient may retain a copy of such Confidential Information solely for archival purpose.
Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law.
Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Confidential Information is retained in the computer backup system of a Participating Entity, the Confidential Information will be destroyed in accordance with the regular ongoing records retention process of the Participating Entity.

acquired_qualification_operation.name: disposal_retention_qualification
acquired_qualification_operation.question: What exception, retention basis, or other qualification limits the disposal or retention effect in these units? Keep authorization, archival retention, legally required retention, absolute non-retention, and linked backup handling distinct.

representation_gap: Only archival-purpose or law-required record-copy conditions can be generated. The actual regulatory-and-agreement-compliance permission cannot be retained faithfully by this finite operation. Existing retention_condition(text) supports retaining the source limits.

unit.text: Upon the Disclosing Party’s request, the Receiving Party will promptly return to the Disclosing Party all materials or tangible items containing the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information and all copies thereof; provided, however, Receiving Party’s legal department or outside legal counsel may maintain a single copy of Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information for purposes of regulatory compliance and compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
